text:
jess: FYI: client libs are moving from ?model=xxx to ?engine=xxx in v3. Some big customers still use model param in many SDKs. We need a lightweight gateway translation and a rollback plan.
owen: Agreed. Proposal: gateway proxy accepts both for a 30-day compatibility window, but logs usage and maps model->engine. After window, we reject model param with 400 and link migration guide.
priya: Can we avoid touching core routers? Put the translation as an ingress plugin so we can hotfix without full router deploy. Envoy/Lua or express middleware for edge would work.
carlos: If we do ingress plugin, perf is critical. Keep it string->string mapping, no model normalization. Also add a rate-limited sampler to capture 0.1% full requests for diffing.
jess: Telemetry plan: emit metric legacy_param_seen{tenant,model_value} and legacy_param_mapped{tenant,engine}. Add a daily job to list top tenants using legacy param and ping them.
owen: Enforcement strategy: Stage 1: translation-only canary (5%). Stage 2: translation at 50% after 48h if no spike. Stage 3: after 30 days, enforcement mode behind ops toggle: reject requests with model param unless tenant opt-in flag present.
priya: For tenant flags, use our existing feature-toggle service (ffsvc) with a per-tenant boolean "allow_model_param". Keep default=false for new tenants. We should avoid DB migrations.
carlos: Edge-case: some customers pass model param with comma-separated list. We'll translate first value only and log warning. Document that behavior.
infra-bot: infra-bot: Canary rollout started for "ingress-translate-model-param-v1" - 5% ingress traffic.
jess: Docs: I'll draft migration guide with code snippets for JS/Python showing engine replacement and how to opt-in for rollback. Also add curl examples returning 400 with helpful message.
owen: Emergency kill-switch: ability to flip translation off cluster-wide via k8s annotation and to turn enforcement on/off per-tenant via ffsvc. Add healthcheck endpoint that reports plugin status.
priya: Implementation notes: keep mapping table in-memory with short TTL (10m) and backfill from Redis on miss. No per-request canonicalization. Add histogram to track plugin latency; alert if p95 > 5ms.
carlos: Billing note: some downstream billing uses model param to map to plans. Make sure billing team gets the telemetry before enforcement so their pipelines don't break.
jess: Owners: Priya implements plugin + metrics, Owen coordinates rollout and ops toggle, Carlos talks to billing, I write docs and tenant comms. Can we target start-of-rollout tomorrow and enforcement after 30 days?
owen: Yep. I'll prepare the rollout playbook and a quick runbook for reverting.
priya: PR coming shortly. Will tag in thread.
carlos: I'll notify billing and product to surface this on account dashboards.
jess: TL;DR: ingress plugin that maps model->engine, 30-day window, per-tenant opt-in for enforcement, telemetry + billing coord, ops kill-switch. Thanks!
